units.step: Isolate and verify the filter boundary
units.hazard: Pressure can return to the housing from connected pipework
units.cause: Closing the inlet alone leaves an outlet header, bypass or shared drain connected
units.consequence: Unexpected air or fluid release when opening the housing
units.control: Trace inlet, outlet, bypass and connected drain paths; isolate every supply and backfeed source using the actual equipment procedure, apply personal locks under that procedure, and safely relieve retained pressure before opening.
units.verification: Verify depressurization at the housing using the prescribed method and check for pressure returning. Keep the housing closed if the boundary or drain communication is uncertain; silence at the drain is not proof, and loosening the bowl is not a pressure test.

units.task: Asphalt cold milling and truck loading
units.hazard: A person may be struck or trapped between the truck and conveyor
units.cause: Uncoordinated movement, poor sight lines or entry into the vehicle gap
units.control: Stop discharge for the exchange, coordinate both drivers and the spotter, keep the vehicle gap and conveyor sweep clear, and use the agreed movement sequence from a safe signaling position with an escape route.
units.verification: Before movement, confirm the shared stop signal, each driver’s sight lines, personnel locations and overhead clearance. Hold milling, discharge and vehicle movement if signals or visibility are lost or anyone enters the gap; resume only after the shared safe sequence is restored.

units.step: Check ventilation and shielding gas arrangements
units.hazard: Welding exposure or oxygen depletion may remain despite little visible smoke
units.cause: Ineffective extraction or accumulation of shielding gas
units.consequence: Harmful inhalation exposure or oxygen-deficiency injury
units.control: Assess ozone exposure and shielding-gas accumulation, provide effective extraction and ventilation, and position the hood so that fume and gas controls do not undermine the welding procedure’s shielding arrangement.
units.verification: Check the exposure and atmosphere assessment, extraction performance and shielding conditions. If the hood or work conditions change, hold welding and recheck both air control and shielding before resuming; little visible smoke does not demonstrate safe air.
